title: Christmas Cards
seo_title: Christmas Card Making in Lebanon, MO on Nov 18
description: This is a card-making class where you create 8 Christmas cards from the Kringle & Co. Collection. The cost is $29, and everything is provided except adhesives and trimmers, which you bring yourself. It takes place Wednesday, November 18, 2026 at 2:00 PM at 301 W. Commercial in Lebanon, MO, with a second session offered on Nov 21.
